scope: repository P2 configs, runners, reports, and tests; artifacts, submissions, and raw data excluded

selected_axis.single_change: append the masked coordinatewise third central moment of the 32 element-embedding coordinates to the exact v13 masked mean, masked maximum, and context before the unchanged head
selected_axis.historical_support: v13 executed all three prefix-purged folds; every selected scoring row uses the finite organizer-distributed public-token mask and the fixed third-central-moment descriptor has an exact zero fallback when support is absent; training rows are 45935, 119667, and 149384
selected_axis.identity_initialization: the new 32 head columns are exactly zero and the original 75 head columns are copied, so the initial function equals v13

distinctions.v15: v15 learns token-token self-attention before pooling; v50 has no attention and uses one fixed coordinatewise signed third central moment
distinctions.v16: v16 passes physical-depth graph messages; v50 has no graph, adjacency, depth kernel, or message passing
distinctions.v20: v20 aligns centered latent covariances across months as a loss; v50 adds no alignment or auxiliary loss
distinctions.v43: v43 applies target-layer FiLM inside token embeddings; v50 does not condition the element encoder on target layer
distinctions.v45_v45c: v45 and v45c stochastically mask Linear weights during training; v50 is deterministic and changes only the pooled descriptor
distinctions.v46: v46 applies LayerNorm to hidden activations; v50 has no normalization
distinctions.v47: v47 learns CrossNet interactions among already pooled coordinates; v50 has no cross layer
distinctions.v48: v48 pools the uncentered nonnegative diagonal second moment mean(z^2); v50 pools the signed centered third moment mean((z-mean(z))^3)
distinctions.v49: v49 pools log(mean(exp(z))) at a fixed temperature; v50 contains no exponential, logarithm, temperature, smooth maximum, or pooling sweep

v49_failure_separation.required_repair: fresh experiment ID plus pre-lock synthetic validation of every inherited source-contract key

primary_source.citation: Zaheer et al., Deep Sets, NeurIPS 2017
primary_source.claim: symmetric aggregation provides a permutation-invariant representation of a set
primary_source.use: representation motivation only; no P2 performance or hyperparameter transfer
